anchor: New York Monday 00:00 through Tuesday 00:00. Upper=H+.618*(H-L), lower=L-.618*(H-L). Take first strict pierce per symbol/week/rail after anchor closes through the next NY Monday open. UTC aligned closed candles, choose 1h then 4h then 12h, wick outside and open/close strictly inside; no repeats. Changed from monthly anchor to weekly Monday.
execution: Next H1 open at decision close, chosen wick extreme plus 1% further out, independently measured fixed 3R. Parent VectorBT rules, taker 5bp entry/stop, maker 2bp TP, no extra slippage or funding. Can hold beyond week, censor at gap/end/delisting. Minute refinement on ambiguous source H1 when obtainable, conservative ordering otherwise.
design: Train each selected confirmation timeframe exclusively on its own rows. Preprocessing and fits use only outcomes known by each fold boundary. For 2023, 2024, 2025 produce expanding-year out-of-fold predictions; only labels known before 2026 may affect selection or calibration. The 2026 final assessment is separate. One independent selection per timeframe.
select: Within each validation year rank executable signals by predicted 3R probability. Use the mean of the three annual top-decile mean settled net Rs as the selection criterion; break ties with lower mean validation log loss then declaration order. Annual ranks serve only for model selection. Fit Platt calibration using pre-2026 settled out-of-fold probabilities, with nonnegative slope. Freeze the raw probability threshold at the pooled pre-2026 out-of-fold 90th percentile across executable signals before predicting any 2026 result. Refit selected model and simple baseline using all pre-2026 matured labels.
evaluate: Report baseline and selected candidates using each model's own frozen validation thresholds. Do not optimize 2026 thresholds. Primary economics: positive high-band mean net R and one-sided p<0.01 versus equal-count draws from settled same-NY-week, direction and timeframe confirmed signals. Weekly cluster bootstrap intervals; include AUC, Brier, counts including censored, and quarterly slices. Independent signal returns.
